validation.scope_note: Structural/script-shape validation only; it does not independently authenticate lexical claims.

notes: Rows whose gloss key did not match the reviewed note were re-keyed: ferhat (Persian فرهاد, 'merited, obtained'), forough (Persian فروغ, 'radiance, glow, light'), foroud (auspiciousness; Shahnameh hero's name), fuzail (diminutive of faḍl), gamze (Turkish 'dimple'), fiza (open expanse, spaciousness), ghadi (active participle of gh-d-w).

Rows that were recorded in the curated table without a gloss were given their reviewed sense: fusun (Turkish form of Persian Afsūn), galawezh (Kurdish bright-star name), galila (variant of Jalīla), gawdat (Egyptian spelling of Jawdat).

Rows with no established lexical meaning carry none: firnas (personal name of Ibn Firnās, no dictionary sense), gaddafi (a nisba/surname), plus the forms that could not be matched to a Tier-A/B source (ferran, fida, fila, filza, filzah, firasha, fizah, fizan, fizzi, fo jan, folla, foram, fouzan, fozhan, fuhad, fullah, fusun is asserted, futoon, gabina, gadaa, geela, galai).
The source record for galawezh gave أحمد (Ahmad) as the 'Arabic form' and labelled the name Arabic; the name is Kurdish and was reclassified.
